level_2._benghazi_note: Faithful, but previously withheld: game.scenario used to keep Benghazi's terrain MAJOR_CITY (for the unlimited 54.12 dump ceiling) while deliberately NOT granting its [25.12] fort, on the stated theory that the fort alone grants [15.82] retreat-immunity. That theory doesn't hold -- 15.82 keys on Terrain.MAJOR_CITY (game/engine.py), not on fortification level -- so Benghazi already had retreat-immunity either way, and withholding the fort was port-rule-6 debt paid here.
